metadata.title: The Overloaded Ferry That Told Passengers to Stay Put
metadata.description:
Sewol capsized off South Korea's southwest coast. The cause: loss of stability from modifications, excess cargo and reduced ballast water.

Failure chain: Extra cabins added on top → Cargo overloaded → Ballast water reduced → Sharp turn → Ship lists and capsizes

Related episode: The Cargo Ship That Sailed Into a Hurricane — https://youtu.be/A-IgHh6J_ZU

Series — Maritime Disasters: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLOjaDNq7OIVc

• Wikipedia — Sinking of MV Sewol — https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sinking_of_MV_Sewol
